format_and_science_gates.type: Professional white background/interiors, Times New Roman, navy/teal line accents, thick scientifically meaningful arrows, no colored fills/shadows/gold

slides_animation_detail.title: 3. Research Problem
slides_animation_detail.scientific_guardrail: Both paths are candidate causal chains. No confirmed bidirectionality, equipment limits, propagation delays, or actual service losses.

clicks.scientific_purpose: Trace the source→constraint→interface→receiver and separate permitted capability from observed service.

clicks.reveal: P→Tₑ evidence gate: source thermal measurement + operating/protection law + interface delivery + receiver/service observations
clicks.scientific_purpose: Show precisely what data must justify the first direction before qualification.

clicks.reveal: Candidate Tₑ→P lane: Tₑ heat-conditioned control/limit; change at GRID-SIDE AC input; Power load/thermal response

clicks.reveal: Separate Tₑ→P evidence gate: measured AC current/power and grid-side P response; rival shared-heat explanation tested
